description: Confirm an impact at t as a fall in the SDK (posture_confirmation): the up direction of a 6D VQF attitude must turn by at least 50 degrees from its mean over [t-2.0 s, t-1.0 s] and hold for 0.1 s within [t, t+1.5 s]; otherwise, at t+1.5 s, the mean accelerometer direction over [t+0.5 s, t+1.5 s] must differ from the [t-2.0 s, t-1.0 s] mean by 50 degrees. Chosen on CGU-BES Subject01-12 (train+validation) only; see evaluation/vqf_confirmation_selection.json.
